name: Canara Bank Securities
bio: Canara Bank Securities Ltd is the wholly owned broking subsidiary of Canara Bank, incorporated in 1996 and headquartered in Mumbai. Operating under the Canmoney brand, it offers equity trading on the NSE and BSE, NSDL depository services, mutual fund distribution and IPO applications, backed by a research desk that publishes equity and primary market coverage for the bank’s retail investor base.

name: Arihant Capital
bio: Arihant Capital Markets, founded in 1992 and headquartered in Indore, is a listed full-service broking and merchant banking firm serving more than two lakh clients through 900-plus investment centres across 200 cities. It covers equities, derivatives, commodities, mutual funds, IPOs and fixed income, and was named India’s Best Retail Brokerage in the Asiamoney Brokers Poll in 2021 and 2022.

name: Nirmal Bang
bio: Nirmal Bang is a Mumbai-headquartered, family-run financial services group offering equity and derivatives trading, commodities, currency, institutional broking, depository services and portfolio management across the NSE, BSE, MCX and NCDEX. Its research arm, Nirmal Bang Equities, publishes fundamental and technical coverage along with IPO notes for retail and institutional clients.

name: Aditya Birla Money
bio: Aditya Birla Money Limited is a listed stock broking and financial services company of the Aditya Birla Capital group, offering solutions across equities, derivatives, commodities, PMS, depository services, and distribution of financial products through a pan‑India network of branches, franchisees, and digital platforms for trading and investing in stocks, mutual funds, IPOs, and bonds.

name: Ajcon Global Services
bio: Founded in 1989, Ajcon Global Services Ltd is a listed Mumbai-based financial services firm offering equity, commodity and currency broking, depository services, mutual fund distribution, investment banking and corporate advisory. Serving over 20,000 clients as a member of the NSE, BSE and CDSL, its research desk publishes equity and IPO notes.

name: Adroit Financial Services
bio: Adroit Financial Services is a Delhi-NCR based broking house registered across the NSE, BSE, MCX and NCDEX, offering equity and derivatives trading, commodities, IPO applications, depository services, margin trading and portfolio management. Its research desk covers equities and derivatives, and the firm runs a wide leased-line trading network alongside its AERO and Breeze trading platforms.

name: SBI Securities
bio: SBI Securities is a trusted and reliable investment company and a wholly owned subsidiary of SBI Capital Markets Ltd, part of the State Bank Group, India’s largest and most trusted banking group. With years of experience and strong expertise in financial markets, SBI Securities focuses on client needs and provides quality investment solutions to help investors confidently achieve their financial goals.

name: Anand Rathi
bio: Founded in 1994 by Anand Rathi and Pradeep Gupta, the Anand Rathi Group is a Mumbai-headquartered financial services house spanning stock broking, wealth management, investment banking, commodities and capital market lending. With roughly 5,500 employees and a presence in over 145 locations, its research desk publishes equity, derivatives and IPO notes for more than 10 lakh registered clients.

name: Geojit Financial Services
bio: Geojit Financial Services is a Kochi-headquartered, listed investment services firm founded in 1994 and backed by BNP Paribas. With around 17 lakh clients, 525 branches across India and the GCC and over Rs 1.1 lakh crore in assets under management, it offers equity, derivatives, commodities, mutual funds, PMS and financial planning, supported by an established research desk.

name: GEPL Capital
bio: Established in 1997, GEPL Capital is a trusted financial services firm with 150+ locations, serving retail and institutional clients through transparent, research-driven advice across equity, mutual funds, IPOs, wealth management, and more. Guided by integrity, teamwork, and a client-first approach, we simplify investing through cutting-edge technology and top-class research—because when our clients grow, we grow.

name: BP Equities
bio: BP Equities, the broking arm of the BP Group founded by Babubhai P Thakker in 1987, is a Mumbai-based full-service broker offering retail and institutional broking, wealth management and research. Its research team of more than 30 analysts tracks over 100 companies across 20 sectors, publishing sector reports, technical trends and IPO notes, and is empanelled with 60-plus institutional clients.

name: DRChoksey FinServ
bio: DRChoksey FinServ, led by veteran market commentator Deven Choksey, is a Mumbai-based research and advisory firm registered with SEBI as a research entity, investment adviser and portfolio manager. The team publishes company initiating coverage, result reviews, sector notes and IPO views, and is widely quoted in the Indian business media on equity strategy.

name: Choice Equity Broking
bio: Choice Equity Broking is the broking arm of the listed Choice International group, established in 1992 and headquartered in Mumbai. Serving over 15 lakh customers through 217 branches and a large associate network, it offers equity and derivatives trading, commodities, mutual funds, insurance and wealth management, with a research desk that publishes regular equity and IPO coverage.

name: ICICI Direct
bio: ICICIdirect is the retail investing platform of ICICI Securities Ltd, part of the ICICI group and in operation since 1995. Known for its 3-in-1 account linking banking, trading and demat, it offers stocks, IPOs, ETFs, bonds, mutual funds and commodities, and its research team publishes one of the most widely followed IPO note series in the Indian market.

name: SMIFS
bio: Established in 1993 and headquartered in Kolkata, SMIFS Limited is a full-service financial intermediary offering equity and commodity broking, wealth management, portfolio management, merchant banking and depository services. With a presence in more than 25 cities and over 31,000 clients, its research desk covers equities, mutual funds and primary market issues.

name: Sushil Finance
bio: Sushil Finance, established in 1982 by Mr. Sushil N. Shah, has grown into one of India’s leading financial services companies, serving the evolving needs of individual and institutional investors for over four decades. With a strong focus on trust, research-driven advice, and investor-friendly solutions, Sushil Finance offers a comprehensive basket of services across equities, mutual funds, insurance, and more to help clients build long-term wealth.

name: Marwadi Shares & Finance
bio: Marwadi Shares and Finance Ltd. (MSFL), incorporated in 1992, is a leading financial services company dedicated to helping individuals and families achieve their financial goals with unmatched value and service. Operating from a state-of-the-art 90,000 sq. ft. corporate office in Rajkot, MSFL leverages advanced technology, a strong professional team, and over 30 years of market experience to deliver seamless, secure, and client-centric trading and investment solutions

name: Ventura Securities
bio: Ventura Securities is a Mumbai-based, SEBI-registered full-service stockbroker founded in 1994, providing comprehensive investment services, including IPO, equity, derivatives, commodities, and mutual funds.

name: Lakshmishree Investment
bio: Lakshmishree Investment & Securities is a Varanasi-rooted, Mumbai-headquartered broking house serving over 60,000 clients through a pan-India branch network. A member of the NSE, BSE and MCX and a CDSL depository participant, it offers equity, derivatives, commodity and currency trading, mutual funds, insurance and IPO applications, with an active research and investor education desk.

name: Kantilal Chhaganlal Securities
bio: Kantilal Chhaganlal Securities is one of Mumbai’s oldest broking houses, established in 1954 and carrying more than six decades of market intermediation experience. The firm is a member of the NSE, BSE, MCX and NCDEX, offering equities and derivatives, commodities, currency futures, mutual funds, IPO applications and CDSL depository services through its KC iTrade platforms.

name: Angel One
bio: Established in 1996, Angel One has grown from a traditional brokerage firm into India’s leading digital-first retail broking house. Guided by a customer-first philosophy and powered by advanced technology, they offer personalized investment journeys through a single, seamless app. Since beginning their digital transformation in 2019, they have expanded their presence across the country—empowering millions of investors, including those in India’s tier-2 and tier-3 cities, to participate confidently in the financial markets.

name: Paresh Gordhandas
bio: CA Paresh Gordhandas is a seasoned Chartered Accountant and SEBI-registered Research Analyst with over 35 years of market experience. He is the visionary behind Chanakya Ni Pothi, a leading investment publication known for its in-depth IPO reviews, stock insights, and research-driven guidance for retail and HNI investors across India.

name: StoxBox
bio: StoxBox, backed by BP Wealth, is a tech-driven value broking platform offering low-cost trading in equities, F&O, mutual funds, and ETFs with free institutional-grade research via StoxCalls and educational tools for confident investing. Its pay-as-you-go model ensures transparency and simplicity for retail traders.

name: EquiVision
bio: EquiVision, the research division of Beacon Capital Advisors Pvt. Ltd., is a results-driven equity research and investor relations firm focused on India's SME and mid-cap landscape. With a commitment to integrity, innovation, and client-centricity, EquiVision delivers customized, actionable insights that guide businesses and investors through every stage of their growth journey — from pre-IPO strategy to post-listing market positioning.

name: Swastika Investmart
bio: Swastika Investmart is an Indore-headquartered, BSE-listed broking house with over three decades in the market and a network of 500-plus locations across 33 cities. It offers equity, derivatives, commodity and currency trading, mutual funds, IPOs and algo trading, and its research desk has been recognised by the MCX for leading member research.

name: Capital Market
bio: Formed in 1986, Capital Market Publishers India Pvt Ltd pioneered corporate databases and stock market magazine in India. Today Capitaline corporate database cover more than 35,000 listed and unlisted Indian companies. Latest technologies and standards are constantly being adopted to keep the database user-friendly, comprehensive and up-to-date. name: Hem Securities
bio: With 35 years of legacy, Hem Group is a leading Indian financial services provider built on trust, transparency, and a deep commitment to wealth creation. Our mission is to empower investors through expert trading and investment strategies rooted in integrity—because we believe lasting wealth is built on lasting relationships.

name: Kunvarji Wealth
bio: The Kunvarji Group traces its roots to 1960 in Patan, Gujarat and today operates from Ahmedabad across wealth management and investment advisory, commodity broking, warehousing, insurance broking and SEBI Category-I merchant banking. Kunvarji Wealth is its investment advisory and research arm, publishing equity and primary market views for retail and HNI clients.

name: Reliance Securities
bio: Reliance Securities, rebranded as IndusInd Securities Ltd from September 2025 after its acquisition by the IndusInd group, is a Mumbai-based full-service broker serving over a million investors. It offers broking across the NSE, BSE, MCX and NCDEX along with mutual funds, IPOs, depository services and advisory, supported by a research desk with a long record of equity and IPO coverage.
